1.name: Pound
1.description: Pounds the foe with forelegs or tail.
1.longDescription: A physical attack delivered with a long tail or a foreleg, etc.

2.name: Karate Chop
2.description: A chopping attack with a high critical-hit ratio.
2.longDescription: The foe is attacked with a sharp chop. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

3.name: Double Slap
3.description: Slaps the foe at least twice. May cause confusion.
3.longDescription: Repeatedly slaps the foe. Each hit after the second has a 10% confusion chance.

4.name: Comet Punch
4.description: Repeatedly punches the foe 2 to 5 times. +1 priority.
4.longDescription: Hits 2 to 5 times. Has +1 priority. Iron Fist boost.

5.name: Mega Punch
5.description: A strong punch thrown with incredible power.
5.longDescription: The foe is slugged by a punch with great power. Iron Fist boost.

6.name: Pay Day
6.description: Throws coins at the foe. Money is recovered after.
6.longDescription: Numerous coins are hurled at the foe. Money is earned after battle.

7.name: Fire Punch
7.description: A fiery punch that may burn the foe.
7.longDescription: The foe is punched with a fiery fist. 10% burn chance. Iron Fist boost.

8.name: Ice Punch
8.description: An icy punch that may leave the foe with frostbite.
8.longDescription: The foe is punched with an icy fist. 10% frostbite chance. Iron Fist boost.

9.name: Thunder Punch
9.description: An electrified punch that may paralyze the foe.
9.longDescription: A punch with an electrified fist. 10% paralyze chance. Iron Fist boost.

10.name: Scratch
10.description: Scratches the foe with sharp claws.
10.longDescription: Hard, pointed, and sharp claws rake the foe.

11.name: Vise Grip
11.description: Grips the foe with large and powerful pincers.
11.longDescription: Huge, impressive pincers grip and squeeze the foe. Very high crit ratio.

12.name: Guillotine
12.description: A powerful pincer attack High critical ratio.
12.longDescription: A vicious tearing attack with pincers. Keen Edge boost. High crit ratio.

13.name: Razor Wind
13.description: Wind slices through Rock for super effective damage.
13.longDescription: super effective vs Rock. +1 priority in tailwind. High crit. keen edge boost.

14.name: Swords Dance
14.description: A fighting dance that sharply raises Attack.
14.longDescription: A frenetic dance of fighting. It sharply raises the Attack stat.

15.name: Cut
15.longDescription: Sharp Steel attack, always crits. Keen Edge boost. Field-based.

16.name: Gust
16.description: A sudden gust of wind. Has +1 priority.
16.longDescription: Strikes the foe with a gust of wind whipped up by wings. Air-based.

17.name: Wing Attack
17.description: Strikes the foe with wings spread wide.
17.longDescription: The foe is struck with large, imposing wings spread wide. Air-based.

18.name: Whirlwind
18.description: Blows away the foe with wind and ends the battle.
18.longDescription: The foe is made to switch out with an ally. In the wild, the battle ends.

19.name: Fly
19.description: Flies up on the first turn, then strikes the next turn.
19.longDescription: A 2-turn move. Use it to fly to any known town. Air-based.

20.name: Bind
20.description: Binds and squeezes the foe for 2 to 5 turns.
20.longDescription: A long body or tentacles are used to bind the foe for four or five turns.

21.name: Slam
21.description: Slams the foe with a long tail, vine, etc.
21.longDescription: The foe is struck with a long tail, vines, etc.

22.name: Vine Whip
22.description: Strikes with slender vines. Has 30% flinch chance.
22.longDescription: The foe is struck with slender, whip-like vines. 30% flinch chance.

23.name: Stomp
23.description: Stomps the foe and terrain flat. May cause flinching.
23.longDescription: Destroys terrain. 30% chance to flinch. Strike boost.

24.name: Double Kick
24.description: A double-kicking attack that strikes the foe twice.
24.longDescription: Kicks the foe quickly twice. Striker boost.

25.name: Mega Kick
25.description: An extremely powerful kick with intense force.
25.longDescription: The foe is attacked by a kick with great power. Striker boost.

26.name: Jump Kick
26.description: A strong jumping kick. May miss and hurt the kicker.
26.longDescription: The user jumps up high, then kicks. Hurts on miss. Striker boost.

27.name: Rolling Kick
27.description: A fast kick delivered from a rapid spin.
27.longDescription: A quick kick from a rolling spin. +1 priority. Striker boost.

28.name: Sand Attack
28.description: Reduces the foe's accuracy by hurling sand in its face.
28.longDescription: A lot of sand is hurled in the foe's face, reducing its accuracy.

29.name: Headbutt
29.description: A ramming attack that may cause flinching.
29.longDescription: The user sticks its head out and rams. 30% flinch chance. Field-based.

30.name: Horn Attack
30.description: Jabs the foe with sharp horns. High crit chance.
30.longDescription: Jabs with sharply pointed horn. High crit. Mighty Horn boost.

31.name: Fury Attack
31.description: Jabs the foe 2 to 5 times with sharp horns, etc.
31.longDescription: Hits 2-5x with a horn or beak. High crit. Mighty Horn boost.

32.name: Horn Drill
32.description: Ignores abilities and stat changes. High crit.
32.longDescription: Ignores the target's ability and stat changes. High crit. Mighty Horn boost.

33.name: Tackle
33.description: Charges the foe with a full-body tackle.
33.longDescription: A physical attack in which the user charges, full body, into the foe.

34.name: Body Slam
34.description: A full-body slam that may cause paralysis.
34.longDescription: The user drops its full body on the foe. 30% paralyze chance.

35.name: Wrap
35.description: Wraps and squeezes the foe 2 to 5 times with vines, etc.
35.longDescription: A long body or vines are used to wrap the foe for four or five turns.

36.name: Take Down
36.description: Slams into the foe, knocking them back and lowering speed.
36.longDescription: Slams the foe back. 20% chance to lower Speed.

37.name: Thrash
37.description: A rampage of 2 to 3 turns that confuses the user.
37.longDescription: The user rampages about for two to three turns, then becomes confused.

38.name: Double-Edge
38.description: A life-risking tackle that also hurts the user.
38.longDescription: A reckless, life-risking tackle that also has 33% recoil damage.

39.name: Tail Whip
39.description: Wags the tail to lower the foe's Defense.
39.longDescription: The user wags its tail cutely, making the foe lower its Defense stat.

40.name: Poison Sting
40.longDescription: Quick and painful sting. Has 10% poison chance. Has +1 priority.

41.name: Twineedle
41.description: Stingers on the forelegs jab the foe twice.
41.longDescription: The foe is stabbed twice with foreleg stingers. 50% poison chance.

42.name: Pin Missile
42.description: Sharp pins are fired to strike 2 to 5 times.
42.longDescription: Sharp pins are shot at the foe and hit two to five times at once.

43.name: Leer
43.description: Frightens the foe with a leer to lower Defense.
43.longDescription: The foe is given an intimidating look that lowers its Defense stat.

44.name: Bite
44.description: Bites with vicious fangs. May cause flinching.
44.longDescription: The user bites with vicious fangs. 30% flinch chance. Strong Jaw boost.

45.name: Growl
45.description: Growls cutely to reduce the foe's Attack.
45.longDescription: The user growls in a cute way, making the foe lower its Attack stat.

46.name: Roar
46.description: Makes the foe flee to end the battle.
46.longDescription: The foe is made to switch out with an ally. In the wild, the battle ends.

47.name: Sing
47.description: A soothing song lulls the foe into a deep slumber.
47.longDescription: A soothing song in a calming voice lulls the foe into a deep slumber.

48.name: Supersonic
48.description: Emits bizarre sound waves that may confuse foes.
48.longDescription: The user generates odd sound waves that confuse foes.

49.name: Sonic Boom
49.description: Launches shock waves that are super effective vs rock.
49.longDescription: The foe is hit with a shock wave that is super effective vs steel types.

50.name: Disable
50.description: Psychically disables one of the foe's moves.
50.longDescription: For a few turns, it prevents the foe from using the move it last used.

51.name: Acid
51.description: Super effective vs Steel. May lower Defense.
51.longDescription: Super effective vs Steel. Hits both foes. 30% chance to lower SpDef.

52.name: Ember
52.description: A weak fire attack that burns the target.
52.longDescription: The foe is attacked with small flames. 100% burn chance.

53.name: Flamethrower
53.description: A powerful fire attack that may inflict a burn.
53.longDescription: The foe is scorched with intense flames. 10% burn chance.

54.name: Mist
54.description: Creates a mist that stops reduction of abilities.
54.longDescription: The ally party is protected by a mist that prevents stat reductions.

55.name: Water Gun
55.description: Squirts water to attack the foe.
55.longDescription: A quick quirt of water. 10% drench chance. +1 priority. Mega Launcher boost.

56.name: Hydro Pump
56.description: Blasts water at high power to strike the foe.
56.longDescription: Blasts with a massive amount of water. 30% drench chance. Mega Launcher boost

57.name: Surf
57.description: Creates a huge wave, then crashes it down on the foe.
57.longDescription: A big wave crashes down on the foe. 20% drench chance. Field-based.

58.name: Ice Beam
58.description: Blasts the foe with an icy beam. May cause frostbite.
58.longDescription: The foe is struck with an icy beam. 10% frostbite chance. Mega Launcher boost

59.name: Blizzard
59.description: Hits the foe with an icy storm. May cause frostbite.
59.longDescription: The foe is blasted with a blizzard. 20% frostbite chance. Weather-based.

60.name: Psybeam
60.description: Fires a peculiar ray that lowers Special Attack.
60.longDescription: A peculiar ray is shot at the foe. that lowers SpAtk. Mega Launcher boost

61.name: Bubble Beam
61.description: Forcefully sprays bubbles that hit repeatedly.
61.longDescription: A spray of bubbles strikes the foe 2-5 times. Mega Launcher boost

62.name: Aurora Beam
62.description: A rainbow-colored beam which lowers the foe's Attack 100%.
62.longDescription: A rainbow-colored attack beam. 100% attack drop. Mega Launcher boost

63.name: Hyper Beam
63.description: Powerful, but leaves the user immobile the next turn.
63.longDescription: Does severe damage. Needs recharging. Mega Launcher boost

64.name: Peck
64.description: Attacks the foe with a jabbing beak, etc.
64.longDescription: Hits 2-5x with a horn or beak. Mighty Horn boost.

65.name: Drill Peck
65.description: A corkscrewing attack with a high critical-hit ratio.
65.longDescription: A corkscrewing attack. High crit. Mighty Horn boost.

66.name: Submission
66.description: A reckless body slam that also hurts the user.
66.longDescription: A reckless, full-body throw attack. 33% recoil damage.

67.name: Low Kick
67.description: A kick that inflicts more damage on heavier foes.
67.longDescription: Inflicts more damage on heavier foes. Striker boost.

68.name: Counter
68.description: Retaliates any physical hit with double the power.
68.longDescription: A retaliation move that counters any physical hit with double the damage.

69.name: Seismic Toss
69.description: Carries the foe into the sky then deals damage based on level.
69.longDescription: Immobilizes and then slams the foe. Inflicts level damage and triggers hazards.

70.name: Strength
70.description: A powerful slam attack. Lowers the user's defenses.
70.longDescription: The foe is slugged at maximum power. Drops Defenses. Field-based.

71.name: Absorb
71.description: Covers the foe with plants that remove stat changes
71.longDescription: Covers the foe with plants that remove stat changes.

72.name: Mega Drain
72.description: An attack that absorbs 75% of the damage inflicted.
72.longDescription: A tough attack that drains 75% of the damage it inflicted to restore HP.

73.name: Leech Seed
73.description: Plants a seed on the foe to steal HP on every turn.
73.longDescription: Plants a seed that steals HP every turn. Never misses if user is Grass-type.

74.name: Growth
74.description: Forces the body to grow. Ups Attack and SpAtk
74.longDescription: The user's body is forced to grow, raising its Atk. and Sp. Atk stat.

75.name: Razor Leaf
75.description: Cuts both foes with sharp leaves. Always crits.
75.longDescription: Both foes are hit with a cutting leaf. Always crits. Keen Edge boost.

76.name: Solar Beam
76.description: Absorbs light in one turn, then attacks next turn.
76.longDescription: Strong 2-turn move. Weather-based. Mega Launcher boost

77.name: Poison Powder
77.description: Scatters a toxic powder that may poison the foe.
77.longDescription: A cloud of toxic dust is scattered. It poisons the foe.

78.name: Stun Spore
78.description: Scatters a powder that may paralyze the foe.
78.longDescription: Wildly scatters powder that paralyzes the foe. Can paralyze Electric-types.

79.name: Sleep Powder
79.description: Scatters a powder that may cause the foe to sleep.
79.longDescription: A sleep-inducing dust is scattered in high volume around a foe.

80.name: Petal Dance
80.description: A rampage of 2 to 3 turns that confuses the user.
80.longDescription: The user attacks with petals for two to three turns, then gets confused.

81.name: String Shot
81.description: Binds the foes with string to harshly reduce Speed.
81.longDescription: The foe is bound with strings shot from the mouth to reduce its Speed.

82.name: Dragon Rage
82.description: Launches shock waves that can damage Fairy mons.
82.longDescription: The foe is hit with a shock wave that can damage Fairy Pokémon neutrally.

83.name: Fire Spin
83.description: Traps the foe in a ring of fire for 2 to 5 turns.
83.longDescription: The foe is trapped in an intense spiral of fire that rages four or five turns.

84.name: Thunder Shock
84.description: An electrical attack that may flinch the foe.
84.longDescription: An electric shock attack with a 30% flinch chance.

85.name: Thunderbolt
85.description: A strong electrical attack that may paralyze the foe.
85.longDescription: A strong electrical attack with a 10% paralyze chance.

86.name: Thunder Wave
86.description: A weak jolt of electricity that paralyzes the foe.
86.longDescription: A weak shock paralyzes the foe. Never misses if user is Electric-type.

87.name: Thunder
87.description: A lightning attack that may cause paralysis.
87.longDescription: A brutal lightning attack. 30% paralyze chance. Weather-based.

88.name: Rock Throw
88.description: Throws small rocks to strike the foe.
88.longDescription: The user attacks with small rocks. Throw-based.

89.name: Earthquake
89.description: A powerful quake, but has no effect on flying foes.
89.longDescription: An earthquake that strikes all Pokémon in battle excluding the user.

90.name: Fissure
90.description: Very powerful attack. Hits both foes.
90.longDescription: The foe is dropped into a fissure. Hits both foes.

91.name: Dig
91.description: Digs underground the first turn and strikes next turn.
91.longDescription: An attack that hits on the 2nd turn. Field-based.

92.name: Toxic
92.description: Poisons the foe with an intensifying toxin.
92.longDescription: Inflicts a poison that gets worse every turn. Never misses if user is Poison-type.

93.name: Confusion
93.description: A psychic attack that causes confusion.
93.longDescription: A weak telekinetic attack that confuses the foe.

94.name: Psychic
94.description: A powerful psychic attack that may lower Sp. Def.
94.longDescription: A strong telekinetic attack. 20% chance to drop foe's SpDef stat.

95.name: Hypnosis
95.description: A hypnotizing move that may induce sleep.
95.longDescription: Hypnotic suggestion is used to make the foe fall into a deep sleep.

96.name: Meditate
96.description: Meditates peacefully to raise Attack and SpDef.
96.longDescription: Meditates to raise Attack and Special Defense.

97.name: Agility
97.description: Relaxes the body to sharply boost Speed.
97.longDescription: The user relaxes and lightens its body to sharply boost its Speed.

98.name: Quick Attack
98.description: An extremely fast attack that always strikes first.
98.longDescription: An almost invisibly fast attack with +2 priority.

99.name: Rage
99.description: A rampage of 2 to 3 turns that confuses the user.
99.longDescription: The user thrashes about for two to three turns, then becomes confused.

100.name: Teleport
100.description: A psychic move for fleeing from battle instantly.
100.longDescription: Use it to flee from any wild Pokémon. Also warps to the last POKé CENTER.

101.name: Night Shade
101.description: Inflicts damage identical to the user's level.
101.longDescription: An attack with a mirage that inflicts damage matching the user's level.

102.name: Mimic
102.description: Copies a move used by the foe during one battle.
102.longDescription: The user copies the move last used by the foe for the rest of the battle.

103.name: Screech
103.description: Emits a screech to sharply reduce the foe's Defense.
103.longDescription: An ear-splitting screech is emitted to sharply reduce the foe's Defense.

104.name: Double Team
104.description: Creates illusory copies to raise evasiveness.
104.longDescription: The user creates illusory copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.

105.name: Recover
105.description: Recovers up to half the user's maximum HP.
105.longDescription: A self-healing move that restores HP by up to half of the user's maximum HP.

106.name: Harden
106.description: Stiffens the body's muscles to raise Defense.
106.longDescription: The user stiffens all the muscles in its body to raise its Defense stat.

107.name: Minimize
107.description: Minimizes the user's size to raise evasiveness.
107.longDescription: The user compresses all the cells in its body to raise its evasiveness.

108.name: Smokescreen
108.description: Obscures the user's party in smoke for 5 turns.
108.longDescription: Obscures the user's party in smoke for 5 turns, increasing evasiveness by 25%.

109.name: Confuse Ray
109.description: A sinister ray that confuses the foe.
109.longDescription: The foe is exposed to a sinister ray that triggers confusion.

110.name: Withdraw
110.description: Withdraws the body into its hard shell to raise Defense.
110.longDescription: The user withdraws its body in its hard shell, raising its Defense stat.

111.name: Defense Curl
111.description: Curls up to conceal weak spots and raise Defense.
111.longDescription: The user curls up to conceal weak spots and raise its Defense stat.

112.name: Barrier
112.description: Forms the Psychic Terrain into a powerful barrier.
112.longDescription: The user sets Light Screen and Reflect if Psychic Terrain is active.

113.name: Light Screen
113.description: Creates a wall of light that lowers Sp. Atk damage.
113.longDescription: A wall of light cuts damage from Sp. Atk attacks for five turns.

114.name: Haze
114.description: Creates a black haze that eliminates all stat changes.
114.longDescription: Eliminates all stat changes among all Pokémon engaged in battle.

115.name: Reflect
115.description: Creates a wall of light that weakens physical attacks.
115.longDescription: A wall of light cuts damage from physical attacks for five turns.

116.name: Focus Energy
116.description: Focuses power to raise the critical-hit ratio.
116.longDescription: The user takes a deep breath and focuses to raise its critical-hit ratio.

117.name: Bide
117.description: Endures attack for 2 turns to retaliate double.
117.longDescription: The user endures attacks for two turns, then strikes back double.

118.name: Metronome
118.description: An unknown power uses any Pokémon move at random.
118.longDescription: An unknown power stimulates the brain into using any move at random.

119.name: Mirror Move
119.description: Counters the foe's attack with the same move.
119.longDescription: The user counters the move last used by the foe with the same move.

120.name: Self-Destruct
120.description: Inflicts severe damage but makes the user faint.
120.longDescription: The user blows up to inflict severe damage. Deals 2x damage if hit first.

121.name: Egg Bomb
121.description: An egg is forcibly hurled at the foe.
121.longDescription: Hurls a hot egg. 30% Burn chance. 1.5x damage under Gravity. Throw-based.

122.name: Lick
122.description: Licks with a long tongue to injure. May also flinch.
122.longDescription: The foe is licked and hit with a long tongue. 30% flinch chance.

123.name: Smog
123.description: An exhaust-gas attack that may also poison.
123.longDescription: The foe is attacked with exhaust gases. 50% poison chance.

124.name: Sludge
124.description: Super effective vs Water. May poison foes.
124.longDescription: Hurls toxic sludge at the foe. Super-effective on Water. 30% poison chance.

125.name: Bone Club
125.description: Clubs the foe with a bone. May cause flinching.
125.longDescription: The foe is clubbed with a bone. 30% flinch chance.

126.name: Fire Blast
126.description: Incinerates everything it strikes. May cause a burn.
126.longDescription: The foe is hit with an intense flame. It has a 20% burn chance.

127.name: Waterfall
127.description: Charges the foe with speed to climb waterfalls.
127.longDescription: A powerful charge attack. 20% flinch chance. Field-based.

128.name: Clamp
128.description: Traps and squeezes the foe for 2 to 5 turns.
128.longDescription: The foe is clamped and squeezed by the user's shell for four or five turns.

129.name: Swift
129.description: Sprays star-shaped rays that never miss.

130.name: Skull Bash
130.description: Tucks in the head, then attacks on the next turn.
130.longDescription: The user raises its Attack on the 1st turn, then attacks on the 2nd turn.

131.name: Spike Cannon
131.description: Launches sharp spikes that strike 2 to 5 times.
131.longDescription: Sharp spikes are fired two to five times. Mega Launcher boost

132.name: Constrict
132.description: Constricts to inflict pain. May lower Speed.
132.longDescription: The foe is attacked with long tentacles or vines. Lowers foe's Speed.

133.name: Amnesia
133.description: Forgets about something and sharply raises Sp. Def.

134.name: Kinesis
134.description: Animates the foe's item, surprising them.
134.longDescription: Causes the foe's item to fly away, removing it and flinching the target.

135.name: Soft-Boiled
135.description: Recovers up to half the user's maximum HP.
135.longDescription: Heals the user by up to half its full HP. It can be used to heal an ally.

136.name: High Jump Kick
136.description: A jumping knee kick. If it misses, the user is hurt.
136.longDescription: A strong jumping knee kick. Hurts on miss. Striker boost.

137.name: Glare
137.description: Intimidates and frightens the foe into paralysis.
137.longDescription: An intense gaze frightens the foe into paralysis. Can paralyze Electric-types.

138.name: Dream Eater
138.description: Takes one half the damage inflicted on a sleeping foe.
138.longDescription: Absorbs half the damage it inflicted on a sleeping foe to restore HP.

139.name: Poison Gas
139.description: Super effective vs Flying. gas that may poison.
139.longDescription: Super effective vs Flying. Hits both foes. 30% chance to poison.

140.name: Barrage
140.description: Hurls round objects at the foe 2 to 5 times.
140.longDescription: Round objects are hurled at the foe to strike two to five times.

141.name: Leech Life
141.description: An attack that steals half the damage inflicted.
141.longDescription: An attack that absorbs half the damage it inflicted. Strong Jaw boost.

142.name: Lovely Kiss
142.description: Demands a kiss with a scary face that induces sleep.
142.longDescription: The user forces a kiss on the foe with a scary face that induces sleep.

143.name: Sky Attack
143.description: Searches out weak spots, then strikes the next turn.
143.longDescription: Raises its Attack on the first turn, then makes a brutal strike on the second.

144.name: Transform
144.description: Alters the user's cells to become a copy of the foe.
144.longDescription: The user transforms into a copy of the foe with even the same move set.

145.name: Bubble
145.description: An attack using bubbles. Always lowers foe's Speed.
145.longDescription: A spray of bubbles hits both foes. 100% chance to drop foe's Speed.

146.name: Dizzy Punch
146.description: A rhythmic punch that may confuse the foe.
146.longDescription: The foe is hit with a rhythmic punch. 20% confusion chance.

147.name: Spore
147.description: Scatters a cloud of spores that always induce sleep.
147.longDescription: The user scatters bursts of fine spores that induce sleep.

148.name: Flash
148.description: Looses a blast of light. 50% chance to drop Atk.
148.longDescription: A blast of light that has 50% chance to drop foe's Atk. Field-based.

149.name: Psywave
149.description: Quick wave of psychic energy. Has +1 priority.
149.longDescription: A quick wave of psychic energy. +1 priority. 10% confusion chance.

150.name: Splash
150.description: Does more damage if the user outweighs the foe.
150.longDescription: The user slams the foe. 20% drench chance. Heavier users are stronger.

151.name: Acid Armor
151.description: Liquifies the user's body to sharply raise Defense.
151.longDescription: The user alters its cells to liquefy itself and sharply raise Defense.

152.name: Crabhammer
152.description: Hammers with a pincer. Has a high critical-hit ratio.
152.longDescription: A large pincer is used to hammer the foe. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

153.name: Explosion
153.description: Inflicts severe damage but makes the user faint.
153.longDescription: The user explodes to inflict terrible damage even while fainting itself.

154.name: Fury Swipes
154.description: Rakes the foe with sharp claws, etc., 2 to 5 times.
154.longDescription: Hits 2-5x with sharp claws or scythes. High crit rate. Keen edge boost.

155.name: Bonemerang
155.description: Throws a bone. Hits airborne targets and strikes twice.
155.longDescription: The user throws a bone that hits the foe once, then once again on return.

156.name: Rest
156.description: The user sleeps for 2 turns, restoring HP and status.
156.longDescription: The user sleeps for two turns to fully restore HP and heal any status problem.

157.name: Rock Slide
157.description: Large boulders are hurled. May cause flinching.
157.longDescription: Large boulders are hurled at the foe. 20% flinch chance. Throw-based.

158.name: Hyper Fang
158.description: Attacks with sharp fangs. May cause flinching.
158.longDescription: The foe is attacked with sharp fangs. 30% flinch chance. Strong Jaw boost.

159.name: Sharpen
159.description: Sharpens its edges to boost Attack and Crit.
159.longDescription: The user sharpens its edges. Raises highest Attack and Crit and sets Cutthroat.

160.name: Conversion
160.description: Boosts SpAtk and Speed and changes type.
160.longDescription: Boosts SpAtk and Speeds and changes its type to its first move's type.

161.name: Tri Attack
161.description: Fires three types of beams at the same time.
161.longDescription: 30% chance to paralyze, burn, or frostbite foes. Uses highest Attack.

162.name: Super Fang
162.description: Attacks with sharp fangs and cuts half the foe's HP.
162.longDescription: The user attacks with sharp fangs and halves the foe's HP.

163.name: Slash
163.description: Slashes with claws, etc. Always crits.
163.longDescription: The foe is slashed with claws, etc. Always crits. Keen Edge boost.

164.name: Substitute
164.description: Creates a decoy using 1/4 of the user's maximum HP.
164.longDescription: The user creates a decoy using one-quarter of its full HP.

165.name: Struggle
165.description: Used only if all PP are gone. Also hurts the user a little.
165.longDescription: An attack that is used only if there is no PP. It also hurts the user.

166.name: Sketch
166.description: Copies the foe's last move permanently.
